sources.snippet: 2024/12/05: We release the InternVL2.5, an advanced multimodal large language model (MLLM) series with parameter coverage ranging from 1B to 78B. InternVL2_5-78B is the first open-source MLLMs to achieve over 70% on the MMMU benchmark, matching the performance of leading closed-source commercial models like GPT-4o.
